meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会调用 agent-browser 命令自动操控浏览器,完成打开网页、点击、填表、截图、提取数据等操作,并返回页面快照与执行结果。
howto.when: 当用户需要访问网页、填写表单、截图等浏览器操作时,Claude 会使用该技能控制浏览器。

say.text: 打开 example.com,截个图存到桌面
say.note: Claude 会打开网页并保存截图

say.text: 帮我填一下这个表单并提交
say.note: Claude 会识别表单并填写提交

say.text: 截取当前页面并标注可点击元素
say.note: 会生成带编号标注的截图

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use the agent-browser command to control a browser, performing operations like opening pages, clicking, filling forms, taking screenshots, and extracting data, then return snapshots and results.
howto.when_en: When the user needs browser operations such as visiting webpages, filling forms, taking screenshots, etc., Claude will use this skill to take over browser actions.

say_en.text: Open example.com and save a screenshot to the desktop
say_en.note: Claude will open the page and save the screenshot

say_en.text: Help me fill out this form and submit it
say_en.note: Claude will identify and submit the form

say_en.text: Take a screenshot of the current page with clickable elements annotated
say_en.note: Generates a screenshot with numbered labels
